full_judgment:
Ms. Nazmun Ara Sultana J: The Government of Bangladesh and others have filed this Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal seeking review of the order dated 12.02.2015 passed by this Division in Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No.1395 of 2014 dismissing the same being barred by limitation. 

 2. The learned Attorney General has submitted before us that the said Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No.1395 of 2014 was out of time by 95 days and this delay was caused for some unavoidable circumstances, but those could not be explained before this Division satisfactorily and consequently the Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal was dismissed on the ground of limitation. The learned Attorney General has submitted further that this impugned order of dismissal of Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal has caused serious inconvenience for the leave-petitioners and in the circumstances, for the ends of justice, the impugned order dismissing the leave petition may he reviewed and be set aside and the Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal may be heard on merit by the condoning the delay of 95 days.
